assets.title: Fir Tree01 — tree C, photographic branch crown
assets.author: Rico Cilliers (model), Rob Tuytel (photographs)
modifications: Extracted tree C from the Poly Haven source collection; the original trunk, bark and dead-branch primitives retain their prior byte-for-byte vertex data and textures.
Retained the previous quantized trunk/bark geometry and 1K WebP textures. The old highly reduced twig primitive rendered as bare sticks even with alpha masking disabled.
Rebuilt only the foliage crown with 339 crossed photographic branch cards (678 triangles), sampling the correct regions of the existing photographed twig diffuse/normal/ARM/alpha atlas.

Used an irregular whorled branch arrangement. The source minimum/maximum bounds and node transforms are preserved so runtime normalization keeps the original world height, centre and collider relationship.
Original photographic twig diffuse plus alpha remain packed as RGBA; double-sided alpha masking uses cutoff 0.32. Runtime alpha-coverage mipmaps keep small leaves visible at RTS zoom distances.
Original C-trunk primitive lacked TEXCOORD_0: retained the previously added continuous cylindrical UVs with wrapped seam vertices.
Pruned unused old twig buffers; no Draco or meshopt decoder is required.

validation.tool: Khronos glTF Validator and actual vendored Three.js GLTFLoader
validation.warning: Four original materials use Three.js runtime-generated tangent space for normal maps.
validation.visualCheck: Native OpenGL ES 3.2 rendered the old and rebuilt tree at 350, 190, 100, 50 and 25 px. New crown visibly retains its leafy silhouette.
